name: Engineering Geology
short: Rocks, minerals and how the ground behaves before you pour concrete.
importantTopics: Rock types and the rock cycle
Igneous structures and their engineering significance
previousYearQuestions: Describe the rock cycle and explain the importance of geology in civil engineering.
Distinguish between cleavage and hardness in mineral identification.
studyGuide: Start with mineral identification, since rock classification builds on it. Practice identifying at least 10 common minerals from hand specimens before theory-heavy units.
